Other customers include companies from the engineering and construction industries. Rigging equipment are essentially assemblies of ropes and fittings for lifting and mooring purposes. Ropes are generally made of steel or synthetic materials such as polypropylene and nylon. Steel ropes are heavier but have longer usable life as compared to synthetic ropes. Depending on the application and the load requirements, the ropes may be further assembled into grommets and slings. The rigging equipment, which combines the ropes, slings or grommets with fittings such as shackles, connects the lifting equipment with the load. Mooring equipment, a type of rigging equipment, such as the mooring wire rope, swivels and anchors connects the floating vessel to the seabed and keeps it on station. Related services comprise mainly load testing, installation of rigging equipment and certification of rigging equipment for further use.
